counterfactual_missing_items: Pulmonary or hilar lymph node involvement
Elevated serum ACE/calcium or other systemic sarcoidosis markers
decisive_items: PET scan:- Revealed cardiac granulomatous disease
A 55-year-old woman with a history of complete heart block (with permanent pacemaker implantation one year prior)
Cardiac MRI:- Patchy late gadolinium enhancement in multiple walls of the heart
response.rationale: R5 uniquely integrates the sentinel complete heart block, ventricular tachycardia, dilated LV with LGE, and PET-proven cardiac granulomatous disease; R4 captures only the dilated LV/EF reduction, R3 only the arrhythmia, and R2 only the heart failure syndrome.

rejected.why: Heart failure is a downstream syndrome and does not explain the complete heart block, VT, LGE, or granulomatous PET findings.
Ventricular tachycardia is a complication of the underlying cardiomyopathy, not the unifying diagnosis; it ignores the MRI and PET evidence of granulomatous disease.
